## Use Inconsolata in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Inconsolata for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Inconsolata', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Inconsolata coding font

An open-source favorite, clear and highly readable. Inconsolata is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Inconsolata is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 15 CodeFont Top Picks.

## Inconsolata FAQ

### Is Inconsolata free?

Yes. Inconsolata is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Inconsolata support ligatures?

No. Inconsolata has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Inconsolata?

Inconsolata is available from Google Fonts and Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
